townSource.identityEvidence: The public image and the local birdseye source are the same Energy Valley plate; the local top-down semantic asset is a derived presentation raster, not surveyed GIS.
townSource.limitation: The oblique planning illustration has perspective and local warping. A central similarity fit does not justify a whole-map road overlay.

officialSpatialEvidence.coordinateCrsAssumption: The published longitude/latitude pairs are treated as WGS84 for the local metric fit; relative crossing order, scale, and rotation—not absolute cadastral position—are the acceptance evidence.

baiduMap.note: Baidu names and POI positions are retained only as authoring evidence; no Baidu tiles or road geometry are distributed.
baiduMap.stationPolicy: The two station POIs validate route order and relative spacing only; they are not fit controls because the planning plate does not identify exact station pixels.

calibrationScope.supportedUse: Author a schematic major-road and Line 17 layer snapped to the existing town graph around the confirmed Wenyu crossing chain.
calibrationScope.unsupportedUse: Do not transform the whole OSM/Baidu road network, terrain, water, buildings, or parcels into the town canvas.

provenance.reviewRule: Only visibly named or ordered features may become confirmed controls. Candidate holdouts remain excluded from acceptance until independently identified.
